properties.name: booking.jobs.enabled
properties.description: Turns on the scheduled jobs of every module: expired holds and unanswered requests (guide 21), cleanup of old access codes (guide 24). False switches them off, for example on a second instance of the application.

properties.name: auth.login-code.hmac-key
properties.description: SECRET (AUTH_CODE_HMAC_KEY). Base64 of at least 32 random bytes: the HMAC key of the access codes (guide 24, part 3). No default: without it the application does not start.

properties.name: notification.mail.from
properties.description: The sender of the emails of the system (MAIL_FROM). The real address of the studio comes before step 14.

properties.name: payment.accounts
properties.description: The Stripe accounts the studio collects on (PAYMENT_ACCOUNTS), comma separated names of lower case letters and digits (D-057, D-060). For each name the SECRETS STRIPE_<NAME>_SECRET_KEY and STRIPE_<NAME>_WEBHOOK_SECRET come from the environment. Empty: no card payments.

properties.name: payment.live
properties.description: PAYMENT_LIVE: true only in production. Every key must then be a live one; false wants test keys only. A mismatch stops the startup (guide 30, 4.2).

properties.name: payment.return-base-url
properties.description: Where Stripe sends the customer back after the payment page (APP_URL), with placeholder paths until step 12 (D-061). Coming back confirms nothing (D-007).

properties.name: payment.stripe.api-base
properties.description: The address of Stripe's API. Only the tests change it, to a fake HTTP server on localhost (guide 31, part 10).
